name: Project Scaffold & Configuration
description: Initialize the exemplar-tools-doc/ project directory with all configuration files for a Vite + React + TypeScript documentation website. Produces exactly 12 deterministic files at known paths: package.json, tsconfig.json, tsconfig.node.json, vite.config.ts, tailwind.config.ts, postcss.config.mjs, vercel.json, index.html, vitest.setup.ts, src/main.tsx, src/index.css, src/App.tsx. PostCSS uses standalone postcss.config.mjs (ESM, no .js). Vitest configured inside vite.config.ts with jsdom environment, globals: true, setupFiles. Dev server port 4000. Path alias @/ → src/. All dependencies pinned to compatible ranges. No .py or .js source files emitted.

functions.name: generateScaffold
functions.description: Generate all 12 project configuration files at the specified output directory. Writes package.json, tsconfig.json, tsconfig.node.json, vite.config.ts, tailwind.config.ts, postcss.config.mjs, vercel.json, index.html, vitest.setup.ts, src/main.tsx, src/index.css, and src/App.tsx. Creates the src/ subdirectory if it does not exist. Returns a ScaffoldResult confirming all files were written and no forbidden file types exist.

inputs.name: options
inputs.description: Generation options including target directory and overwrite behavior.

error_cases.name: directory_not_found
error_cases.condition: The parent directory of options.outputDir does not exist on the filesystem.

error_data.path: The resolved outputDir path that was not found

error_cases.name: file_already_exists
error_cases.condition: options.overwrite is false and at least one of the 12 target files already exists.

error_data.existingFiles: JSON array of file paths that already exist

error_cases.name: write_permission_denied
error_cases.condition: The process does not have write permissions to the output directory or src/ subdirectory.

error_data.path: The path where permission was denied

error_cases.name: invalid_output_dir
error_cases.condition: options.outputDir is empty, contains null bytes, or is otherwise not a valid filesystem path.

preconditions: options.outputDir is a valid filesystem path
If options.overwrite is false, none of the 12 target files may already exist

src/index.css contains @tailwind base, @tailwind components, @tailwind utilities directives

functions.name: validateScaffold
functions.description: Validates an existing project directory against the scaffold contract. Checks that all 12 files exist, package.json contains all required dependencies, vite.config.ts has correct port and vitest settings, vitest.setup.ts imports jest-dom, vercel.json has the SPA rewrite, and no .js or .py files exist anywhere in the output tree.

inputs.description: Absolute path to the project directory to validate.

validators.error_message: projectRoot must be a non-empty string.

error_cases.name: directory_not_found
error_cases.condition: projectRoot does not exist or is not a directory.

error_data.path: The projectRoot path that was not found

preconditions: projectRoot exists and is a readable directory
postconditions: Result enumerates all validation checks with pass/fail status
Result.isValid is true only if all checks pass

structured_side_effects.target: All 12 scaffold files + recursive directory listing
structured_side_effects.description: Reads scaffold files to verify content and scans directory tree for forbidden .js/.py files.

invariants: Exactly 12 files are produced, no more, no fewer — paths enumerated in ScaffoldFilePath
No file with a .js extension is ever produced (postcss uses .mjs, all others use .ts/.tsx)
No file with a .py extension is ever produced
All dependency version ranges are pinned to the specified caret ranges and never use latest or *
vitest.setup.ts always contains the import '@testing-library/jest-dom' statement
vercel.json always contains exactly one rewrite rule: { source: '/(.*)', destination: '/index.html' }
src/main.tsx always imports React from 'react' as the first import
src/App.tsx always has both a named export and a default export
postcss.config.mjs is ESM (export default) not CommonJS (module.exports)
getProjectManifest and getRequiredDependencies are pure functions with deterministic output

data_access.rationale: Writes project configuration files (package.json, tsconfig.json, vite.config.ts, etc.) to the local filesystem. All written data is PUBLIC — these are standard open-source project scaffolding files containing no secrets, credentials, or user data. The validateScaffold function reads these same PUBLIC files back for verification. No PII or INTERNAL data is involved.

side_effects.rationale: Writes 12 deterministic project configuration and source entry-point files to the output directory. All content is static, open-source-safe configuration with no dynamic or sensitive data.

validateScaffold reads scaffold files to verify correctness: checks dependency versions in package.json, port and vitest config in vite.config.ts, jest-dom import in vitest.setup.ts, rewrite rule in vercel.json, and scans directory tree for forbidden .js/.py files.

authority.rationale: This component is the single source of truth for the project's build configuration, dependency versions, and toolchain setup. All other components depend on the file paths, dependency availability, and build settings established here. No other component may modify package.json, tsconfig.json, vite.config.ts, or other root configuration files.
